notes: Historical claims only. Does not include the 20 current claims in claims.json. Dates are relative to 2026-06-16. Used by RiskAgent to compute prior_claims_count, late_reports, disputed_claims, and duplicate_damage_patterns.

history.damage_description: Rear bumper scraped and dented in a supermarket car park. No other vehicle identified.
history.notes: Straightforward parking lot claim. Settled automatically.

history.notes: Minor claim. Estimate close to deductible threshold. Settled automatically.

history.damage_description: Rear bumper damaged when a car reversed into the vehicle at a petrol station. Third party admitted fault.
history.notes: Third party fault confirmed. Settled automatically.

history.damage_description: Front bumper scraped against a pillar in an underground car park.

history.damage_description: Front windscreen cracked by a stone chip on the motorway. Replaced by registered glazing workshop.
history.notes: Glass claim under AUTO-COMP-001. Zero deductible applied. First glass claim for this customer.

history.damage_description: Side window broken in a break-in. Crime reference number submitted.

history.notes: Claim rejected after adjuster investigation. Damage in photograph assessed as pre-existing and inconsistent with reported incident date. Customer disputed the rejection but investigation was upheld.

history.damage_description: Front quarter panel and bumper dented when another car changed lanes and clipped the vehicle on the motorway.
history.notes: Settled after manual review given previous disputed claim. Evidence was consistent on this occasion.

history.damage_description: Driver door scraped against a metal gate while reversing out of a driveway.
history.notes: Single-vehicle claim. Photograph submitted and consistent. Settled automatically.

history.damage_description: Rear bumper dented in a low-speed rear-end collision in a residential street.
history.notes: First of three claims in 18 months. Routine at this stage.

history.damage_description: Driver door and rear quarter panel damaged in a side collision at a junction.
history.notes: Second claim within 8 months. Referred to manual review per Clause 5.4 (two claims at this point). Evidence consistent. Approved with note to monitor.
